theme: An open Saturday with a full house.
greeting: The calendar's clear today, Dan, and the four girls are with you and Mike in St. Pete. The only fixed point is tomorrow's early board review, so today is a good chance to close the Croatia bookings that keep sliding before you fly on the 8th.

needsAttention.title: Sunday board review with Mike at 9 AM
needsAttention.detail: Tomorrow opens with the 15-minute review on your shared board with Mike, where everything gets an owner and a date and anything stalled three weeks gets cut. A quick skim of the open travel items tonight makes it move fast.

needsAttention.title: Nautilus charter balance still unpaid
needsAttention.detail: QuickBooks shows invoice 2170 to Nautilus Sailing open with a balance due, which is the Croatia charter. Worth clearing before departure, since connectivity aboard is poor.

needsAttention.title: Book the Cavtat night for Sept 19
needsAttention.detail: Your P1 task to book the last Croatia night in Cavtat plus the noon transfer from ACI Komolac is overdue since Aug 26. It has to be booked from land before you fly Sept 8.

needsAttention.title: Book the St Pete landing gap, Sept 20-22
needsAttention.detail: The two nights in St Pete after you land from Croatia and before the kids' Tuesday pickup are still unbooked, overdue since Aug 25. The same Sept 8 wall applies.

flagged.title: Nautilus charter invoice open
flagged.detail: QuickBooks flags invoice 2170 to Nautilus Sailing as not yet paid, the Croatia charter balance.

flagged.title: Care.com sitter, message waiting
flagged.detail: A caregiver messaged through Care.com and is waiting to hear back, alongside several new applicants to your posting.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and promos, FT, Breeze, Filorga, and your Italian word of the week.

resolved.title: Tim Soley accepted your invite
resolved.detail: Your LinkedIn invitation to Tim Soley was accepted, so that connection is now open.

recipe.title: Squid with Chili and Clams
recipe.why: High summer rewards quick, high-heat cooking that lets bright seafood and fresh chili carry the plate.

tasks.title: Confirm checked bags are on the Croatia ticket, in writing
Book refundable backup car, Sept 20 - Oct 5 (TPA)
Buy EU plug adapters and a US power strip

acts.line: A full house this weekend, with the four girls at yours and Mike's in St. Pete and nothing on the calendar to break the morning.
No meetings hold the middle of the day, so it is open for the Croatia bookings still sitting overdue on the board.
Tomorrow starts early with the 9 AM board review, one quiet thing worth teeing up tonight.
